hotels.title: Sydney Eco-Luxury: Taronga Zoo Retreat with Daily Breakfast, Koala Experience & Zoo Tours
hotels.description: Discover a bucket-list hidden gem on Sydney’s iconic harbour, wrapped in earthy details with curious koalas, distinctive echidnas and playful platypus roaming around just beyond your windows. This elegant eco-retreat is located in the heart of Sydney's Taronga Zoo and is designed to blend seamlessly into the lush bushland while boasting unmatched views of Sydney's iconic skyline. At this stunning retreat, savour sophisticated rooms that encapsulate the surrounding zooscape. Tuck into a buffet breakfast at the award-winning Me-Gal Restaurant, serving a seasonal Australian selection, and enjoy quiet moments in the 360-degree open-concept N'Gurra Lounge overlooking Sydney Harbour. With exclusive access to the retreat’s wildlife sanctuary, you’ll have the rare opportunity to encounter native wildlife after hours. Once the crowds have departed, take a night walk in the wild and hear stories of the zoo’s residents. With an early start, uncover the Wollemi Aviary where native birds put on a show, and learn all about the native koalas and the conservation efforts of Taronga as you walk through the treetop Gulamany Nura Koala haven with an expert guide.
